items.q: Do I need a consultation before my first appointment?
items.a: For lash extensions and permanent makeup, yes, and it is built into the appointment rather than billed separately. We map the set or the brow before any work starts.

items.q: How do I book with a specific artist?
items.a: Every artist at Flirt keeps their own book. When you book online you choose the artist first, then the service, so you are always seeing that person's real availability.

items.q: Can I come in with makeup on?
items.a: For lash appointments, please arrive with a clean, makeup-free eye area. Anything left on the lash line shortens retention, and cleaning it off eats into your appointment time.
Five minutes is plenty. Parking is directly outside the suite.
